subject: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare — MAP draft & reforecast
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@acmehealth.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare - MAP draft & next steps

Hi Evan / Jill,

Great to meet earlier today - thanks for the time. Per our discovery, I put together a first draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close date so we have a shared view. A few key items from the call pulled into the MAP: 

- Target scope: Inference for clinical summarization (pilot/P0) + embeddings for search (P1).
- Initial PoC scope: 2 models, 3 datasets (de-identified).
- Security: Full security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence required before PoC.
- Procurement: Standard procurement + legal review (Acme procurement lead is Jill).
- Recommended target close date (internal): 2026-04-30 (assumes procurement completes in Mar/Apr).

Attached: Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (milestones + responsibilities). Please review and let me know any adjustments on owners, milestones, or timing. If that target close date looks aggressive on your side given your budget cycle, call it out and we'll reforecast - goal is to align expectations early.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your review and confirm owners (Evan / Jill) - reply with any changes by Fri 20 Feb.
2) We'll circulate an updated MAP (v2) that incorporates timing changes.
3) Schedule technical kickoff after security questionnaire is returned.

Thanks - happy to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: milestones, owners, dependencies)

From: Evan Turner <evan.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare - MAP draft & next steps

Thanks Marissa - good recap and thanks for pulling the MAP together. A couple of notes from our side after syncing with procurement and finance: 

- Procurement / budget window: our next procurement approval window is the end of May (we missed the March cutoff), so procurement/legal review will likely finish mid-May at the earliest.
- Decision owners: Jill will lead procurement/legal, I'll own the technical validation/POC signoff.
- Security: We'll start the security questionnaire this week but expect at least 3 weeks to complete internal review.

Given this, the 2026-04-30 close is optimistic. Can we reforecast target close to 2026-06-25 and move the procurement milestone accordingly?

Also, can you update the MAP to show procurement complete by mid-May and PoC scheduled for late May/early June (after security sign-off)? If possible include a note about required deliverables for the PoC (data access SLA, test data checklist).

Appreciate it - Jill and I will review v2 when you send it.

- Evan
Evan Turner
Director, Digital Platforms | Acme Healthcare
evant.turner@acmehealth.com | (202) 555-4412

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@acmehealth.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare - MAP draft & reforecast

Thanks for the heads up, Evan - totally understood on the procurement window. I've updated the MAP (attached: Acme-MAP-v2.xlsx) to reflect the reforecasted timeline and reprioritized milestones. High-level changes in v2: 

- Target close date: moved from 2026-04-30 -> 2026-06-25 (decision owner: Evan/Jill).
- Procurement milestone: moved to complete by 2026-05-15 (owner: Jill Park / procurement@acmehealth.com).
- Security review: start 02/24, expected complete by 03/17 (owner: Acme InfoSec).
- PoC window: provisionally scheduled 05/25-06/10 (contingent on security + procurement).
- Dependencies: added data access SLA, IRB/PHI approval (if needed), and legal SOW signoff.
- Action items: added explicit deliverables for PoC (dataset checklist, success criteria, test scripts).

Sooj and Rishi - tagging you for capacity planning: can Redwood provision a small dedicated pool for the PoC in late May if Acme confirms data readiness? If there are cost impacts we can put them in the MAP notes; we may also offer a short PoC credit if helpful.

Evan / Jill - please confirm owners and the reforecasted close (2026-06-25) and I'll lock MAP v2 and share with your procurement/legal. If anything else should move earlier/later, flag it and I'll iterate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Acme-MAP-v2.xlsx (updated timeline + milestone owners)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare - MAP draft & reforecast

Marissa / Rishi - thanks for the update and for surfacing the timeline shift. We can support a PoC window late May -> early June with a small reserved pool (2 GPUs) for the PoC. Parking notes: 

- Cost: estimate ~ $6k for the reserved PoC capacity (2 GPUs, 2 weeks) - we can discuss a pilot credit to offset.
- Engineering support: one part-time infra engineer for provisioning and one part-time ML engineer for model onboarding; Monica is aligned to lead CS engagement.
- Compliance: if Acme requests on-prem or VPC deploy for the PoC, that will add configuration time (estimate +5 business days).

I'll work with Rishi to finalize a short internal playbook and a pricing note to include in the MAP v2 notes. Rishi - can you sanity-check the cost estimate and we'll include a line item in the MAP?

- Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Evan Turner <evan.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: Redwood Inference + Acme Healthcare - MAP draft & reforecast

Marissa / team - thanks for the quick turnaround on v2. Jill and I reviewed internally and we're aligned on the revised milestones. Confirming: 

- Procurement will start routing next week; procurement lead (Jill) expects approvals by ~2026-05-15.
- Security questionnaire is in progress; we'll get that back to you by 2026-03-18.
- Accept the reforecasted target close: 2026-06-25.
- PoC: we'll confirm exact test dates after procurement sign-off - tentatively late May.

Please proceed to lock MAP v2 into your internal tracker and we'll loop procurement on the SOW (we expect to sign via DocuSign once legal approves).

Thanks - Evan
